delivery.outcome: Deliver and independently publish a pinned HTTPS Koru client for actual repository admission acquisition and current authoritative lease checks, and validate it against the operator-authorized deployed Autonom controller.
nonGoals: No broad self-issued fleet policy or new publication grants.
No bypass of native staging or independent Validator.

architecture.decision: Use an externally pinned transport configuration, verified TLS controller identity, credential file outside the target checkout, exact request/response bindings and fresh server checks. Keep credentials private and retain the separate publication boundary.
interfaceChanges: Koru repository admission acquire/check Python and module CLI interface.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material client commit; preserve authoritative existing leases and native allocations.

validation.evidence: Verified HTTPS, exact native worktree admission, unavailable/mismatched/expired authority and current CAS/fencing checks.
